answer: Standing is a haven that only stays warm when it is heated by fires from other havens: each epoch’s work must be verified by established peers from at least three different havens — a tundra of standing is the coldest haven count in any single epoch, and an oasis only stays wet when water flows in from other havens. A farm of a thousand fakes is a single haven: its members all live in one haven, so they cannot verify each other’s work — and one epoch verified only by a single haven adds nothing.
